qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve older heavyset figure, white linen outfit, gray beard, gold glasses/jewelry, cigar and amber tumbler. Review drawer slam, glass/cigar hand continuity, receipt bounds and title. No added golden-fist effects.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact heavyset older brown-skinned man with close-cropped hair, salt-and-pepper beard, large gold-framed tinted glasses, open white linen shirt, loose white trousers, dark brown loafers with gold hardware, thick gold chains, round medallion, rings, bracelet and forearm tattoo. Preserve the cigar in his right hand and amber drink with ice in his left. Confident indulgent smile.
0–0.7s: establish full body. An elegant small red-and-brass cash register floats in front of him. He casually presses its single large button with his cigar-holding hand's extended index finger, keeping the glass perfectly level.
0.7–2.5s: the register expands to outrageous scale as its drawer fires outward like a thirty-foot piston. Camera rockets backward to reveal the enormous drawer smashing into a giant floating charcoal padded target, launching it tumbling into the cyan distance. One massive ivory/copper impact star, a momentary drawer-contact hold, then rushing deep perspective. Coins and blank receipt curls jump briefly inside the open drawer, but no scenery, counter, bar, floor or casino. Keep all props finite with cyan between and around them.
2.5–3.5s: the drawer retracts into the now-small register with an enormous triumphant CHA-CHING. Camera snaps back up to his pleased face as exact title OPEN TAB slams below his medallion. His drink is still level, its ice finally making one little clink.
3.5–5s: full-body hero hold. The register prints an absurdly long blank receipt curling down past his knees; he gives it one unconcerned glance and flicks the receipt neatly into his open shirt pocket using two free fingertips of the cigar hand. Stable correct hands, untouched costume, cigar and tumbler. SFX: tiny button click, accelerating cash-drawer cannon whoosh, giant padded CRASH, retreating mechanism, huge CHA-CHING, title slam, paper flutter and ice clink. No speech, music or extra readable text.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve older father, navy/cream/gold traditional outfit and cap, glasses, beard, cane, keys and checklist. Existing garment emblems remain; no new fist effects. Review finite book structures, full-body cane motion, checklist continuity and readable title.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact dignified older brown-skinned man with gold-framed rectangular glasses, short salt-and-pepper beard, navy traditional robe with ornate gold trim over cream tunic and trousers, matching patterned navy cap, polished dark brown loafers with gold hardware, wristwatch and rings. Preserve his slender dark cane with ornate gold handle, dangling keys and small paper checklist. Keep the source outfit's existing markings; do not invent new emblems. Stern, patient, quietly formidable.
0–1.2s: full-body view. He glances at the little checklist and raises one index finger. In front of him floats one modest closed navy textbook with cream pages. He taps it once with his cane tip, then points higher.
1.2–3.2s: camera cranes rapidly upward and backward as that little book becomes the base of an astonishing towering spiral of enormous navy-and-ivory textbooks. The books hinge open sequentially like powerful mechanical wings, lifting the little original book upward through the spiral. He remains clearly visible below, cane directing the ascent like a conductor. These are separate floating book props with broad cyan gaps, no library, walls, floor or solid staircase background. He gives a tiny dissatisfied head shake and raises his finger HIGHER; the tower stretches even further.
3.2–4.8s: he makes one decisive upward cane sweep. The entire huge spiral folds inward in an accelerating chain of book-cover CLAPS, squeezing all its momentum into the small original book at its peak. A gigantic bounded ivory/bronze impact star erupts on the final clap with a powerful hold and thunderous textbook BOOM. The original book bursts out above the formation wearing a single academic graduation cap, surrounded by one clean bronze protective ring. No crowns, fist effects, floating numbers or extra words.
4.8–6s: camera races back down as the giant book props shrink into a single normal-sized closed volume that lands perfectly in his free hand. Exact title HIGH EXPECTATIONS slams below his face in two forceful comic lines. The capped little book floats proudly beside his shoulder.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold. He inspects the floating graduated book, gives the smallest possible approving nod, then calmly lifts his pointing finger one inch higher again. The little graduation cap droops comically in response. Checklist and keys give a small settling flutter. Stable face, ornate robe and cane. SFX: checklist rustle, cane tap, accelerating heavy pages, rising cover creaks, three dominant cover claps ending in a colossal BOOM, soft book catch, title impact and tiny cap flop. No speech, accent imitation, narration or music.
name: Nigerian Father
